prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The STL decomposition reveals rf as the trend champion (1.0 correlation) and catboost as the seasonality champion (0.5221 correlation), while ONLY_DWT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (318.97). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=33.18) combined with high seasonality variance (0.68) and concept drift detection strongly favor STL-hierarchical stacking, which can exploit the additive decomposition structure while handling the divergent pattern strengths across models. Early horizon specialist rf (148.68 RMSE) differs from late specialist ONLY_DWT_rf (437.26 RMSE), further supporting decomposition-aware combination over simple averaging.
